quarterly_data.quarter: Ginkgo Bioworks press release: Ginkgo Datapoints Announces Partnership with TuneLab to (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ginkgo Datapoints entered into a new agreement with Lilly TuneLab, the collaborative AI/ML drug discovery platform created by Eli Lilly, under which Ginkgo Datapoints will provide discovery data generation services, including small molecule developability (ADME) and antibody developability testing, to TuneLab companies. Ginkgo says its screening returns results in ML-ready formats that plug directly into TuneLab's predictive models, and new TuneLab members can now submit Datapoints-generated data to access additional platform model benefits. Ginkgo calls it the latest expansion of Ginkgo Datapoints' services tailored to AI/ML.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: partner (Lilly TuneLab platform; services go to TuneLab companies)
